comment: QUESTS.md E4, ALD-3 The Chapter House. Mordaunt's first look with Aldric is the published 'The committee will write.'; his second is Thursday: the committee (Mordaunt, four times), the findings, the request to remain in one place, Knight Commander offered and declined, and the pin issued to the knight - Knight Errant, At Large, his nickname. One trope, no blush, his story. Afterwards for everybody: Mordaunt, the great map without red pins, the committee's card.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._blushes = $gameVariables.value(7); window._stories = $gameVariables.value(15); window._gold = $gameParty.gold(); window._lines = []; }; window._mark(); window._pick = undefined; const sc = Game_Message.prototype.setChoices; Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = function (c, d, k) { return sc.call(this, c, window._pick === undefined ? d : window._pick, k); }
